scripts.dev: docker compose up -d --wait db && pnpm build:libs && pnpm --parallel --filter @shareinference/api --filter @shareinference/web dev
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec -e DB_POOL_MAX=2 api node dist/migrate.js latest
scripts.db:rollback: docker compose exec -e DB_POOL_MAX=2 api node dist/migrate.js rollback
scripts.db:status: docker compose exec -e DB_POOL_MAX=2 api node dist/migrate.js status
scripts.users: docker compose exec -T api node dist/users.js
scripts.credit: docker compose exec -T api node dist/users.js credit
scripts.ledger: docker compose exec -T api node dist/users.js ledger
scripts.ledger:check: docker compose exec -T api node dist/users.js ledger:check
scripts.fake-worker: docker compose exec -T api node dist/devFakeWorker.js
